notes: Official Korean Mathematical Olympiad header wordmark. GIF converted losslessly to PNG at its original 246×49 dimensions; colors, complete wording and proportions preserved.

Official Korean Mathematical Society header logo for its university mathematics competition (대학생 수학 경시대회). No separate permanent competition logo was located. Original 232×87 PNG preserved; this identifies the organizer, not a separate competition emblem.

Official Chinese Mathematical Society header logo for China's national final / National Middle School Mathematics Winter Camp (CMO), not the Canadian Mathematical Olympiad. Original SVG preserved. It contains one embedded PNG and local pattern/image references; checked for scripts, event handlers, foreignObject, remote hrefs and CSS external resources, with none present.

USAMO acronym cropped from the actual bold section heading of the MAA 2004 USAMO Teacher Manual, originally distributed on the University of Nebraska-Lincoln official AMC website and preserved by the Internet Archive. This is a historical publication title wordmark, not a claim of a separate permanent USAMO emblem. First PDF page rendered at 600 dpi; only the original USAMO title fragment and its white margin retained, without retyping, rearrangement, recoloring or aspect-ratio changes (576x121 PNG). No annual date, personal information or generic MAA logo included.

Distinct William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition wordmark with its blue polyhedron, published by Baylor University Mathematics with its 2021 Baylor Putnam Team news item (https://math.artsandsciences.baylor.edu/news/story/2021/2021-baylor-putnam-team). The original white-band competition graphic is cropped from the news thumbnail; surrounding chalkboard decoration and excess white margin removed. All competition wording, registered-trademark symbol, original colors and proportions retained; JPEG decoded to PNG without resizing (683x178). Not the generic MAA organizer mark or Putnam Investments logo.

Official American Mathematics Competitions (AMC) program wordmark displayed on the MAA student portal linked from the official AMC program page, https://maa.org/student-programs/amc/. It identifies the AMC program including AMC 8, AMC 10 and AMC 12; distinct from the generic MAA organizer mark. Original 204x70 PNG preserved without alteration, recoloring or aspect-ratio changes.
